column1: # nix-heavy-attrs.tsv — v-nix OWNS this content; v-fleet-tooling's nix-shim reads it (git-toplevel/fleet/).
# Purpose: close the check-lease ESCAPE hole (all-nix mandate; the load-108 daemon incident 2026-08-29).
# A BARE `nix build` of a heavy check attr run by an agent OUTSIDE the leased gate-local path escapes the
# concurrency cap and can starve the shared daemon. The shim WARNS on the bare-heavy-nix escape (WARN-only,
# never blocks; fail-open; CDZ_NO_NIX_SHIM=1 kill-switch — see v-ft's design).
# ⚠ substitute=false is NOT warned (corrected 2026-08-29): `cargo xtask gate` DELIBERATELY passes
# `--option substitute false` for `.#checks.…corpus-*` builds per an OPERATOR DIRECTIVE (main.rs ~3974,
# sourced from v-nix's substituter RCA) — corpus-* are __contentAddressed + LOCAL-ONLY, so a remote
# substituter realisation query is a guaranteed MISS that STALLED a whole-corpus sweep ~1.5h. So
# substitute=false there is CORRECT (avoids the stall), NOT wasteful — the repo has no remote cache for its
# own derivations, so it never loses a real cache-hit. Warning on it = false-positive spam on every gate.
# (The rare genuinely-bad case — substitute=false on a build needing a fresh nixpkgs toolchain dep — is
# handled by the CDZ_GATE_SUBSTITUTE=1 escape, not a shim warn.)
#   RECURSION EXEMPTION (critical): the SANCTIONED leased builds (run_gate_local / with_lease / the cargo-shim
#   `nix run` routes for .#build/.#test) set CDZ_LEASED_NIX=1 before exec-ing nix. The shim MUST exempt when
#   that marker is set — else it warns on gate-local's own inner `nix build` of local-gate (infinite/false).
#   So the shim only ever warns on an UNMARKED bare agent invocation.
#   KEY=heavy-attr  → VALUE is a glob pattern (globs * ? ok) matched against the check attr NAME (the part
#                     after `.#checks.<system>.`). A bare unmarked `nix build … .#checks.<sys>.<name>` whose
#   KEY=warn:heavy  → the message the shim prints for a matched heavy-attr escape.
# (There is intentionally NO warn:substitute-false key — see the ⚠ note above; substitute=false is
#  operator-directed-correct for corpus builds, not wasteful in this repo.)
# v-nix maintains the patterns as checks are added/renamed; PR edits freely (v-ft does not gate this content).

column2: This is a HEAVY leased-gate build. Run it through the lease: `cargo xtask fleet gate-local` (the authoritative full gate) or the scoped `nix run .#fast-gate` for touched crates — both acquire the check-lease and count against the concurrency cap. A BARE `nix build` of a heavy check escapes the lease and can starve the shared daemon (the load-108 incident, 2026-08-29). If you must build one check directly, wrap it: `cargo xtask fleet with-lease -- nix build …`.
